versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-terraform-code-generation v0.0.1

- Initial release for generating validated Terraform HCL for Alibaba Cloud infrastructure.
- Supports major Alicloud resources: VPC, ECS, ApsaraDB RDS, OSS, SLB/ALB, Function Compute v3, ACK, and any `alicloud_*` provider resource.
- Pulls up-to-date resource docs from provider documentation at generation time—no local gold HCL examples maintained.
- Enforces strict rules: never requests/prints credentials, never runs `terraform apply`, never fakes command output.
- Follows a detailed step-by-step workflow with catalog lookups, required attribute verification, and proof-of-read before generating HCL.
- Multi-language triggers supported, including English and Chinese queries.
